title: Humanity of Christ
definition: The humanity of Christ means that the eternal Son of God became truly human, possessing a real body, mind, will, emotions, and human experience, yet without sin.
summary: Jesus entered the fullness of human weakness, suffering, temptation, grief, hunger, weariness, and death. He did this without sin so that He could represent us, sympathize with us, and redeem us.
christFocus: Christ knows human weakness from the inside, yet He never sinned. The believer can come boldly to Him because He is both holy Savior and merciful High Priest.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content: His humanity was real, not appearance only.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: His sinlessness does not make Him less human; it shows humanity as God intended it to be.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: His true humanity is essential for His obedience, suffering, death, resurrection, and priestly ministry.
